reason: Bridge -> Reasoning, on both `because` and `given`. The 2026-07-30 bridge (validation.9d04fd325ceba399) carries Unit 42's first reconstruction of an open-weight model - DeepSeek wired into the Hermes Agent framework - running an offensive campaign with no human in the loop: enumeration across ten product families, PoC retrieval, FOFA target discovery, version checks and attempted exploitation, with Unit 42 concluding a functional end-to-end autonomous offensive capability. That makes `because` ("OpenAI's own models chained a real zero-day to autonomous RCE") historical rather than the live precondition, and moves the open gap from AUTONOMY to EFFICACY - every exploit the agent attempted failed, and the actual breaches were by hand. `given` is worse off: it claims the mechanism is "anyone can fine-tune out refusals", but the observed operator did no de-alignment at all - the same bridge and validation.50650b2e4ae81cd8 record OpenAI refusing his requests and disabling his account, after which he simply switched to a model that never refused. The real mechanism is model substitution, not refusal removal. Also reframe against validation.a451d0ab93c7e9ca (07-26: open-weight Kimi K3 driving 32 agents to 19 Redis zero-days and a 27-minute authenticated RCE PoC) and validation.acc41140f80c524d (07-29: Hugging Face published the full step-indexed 17,600-action chain, a public blueprint a reproducer can work from).
